title: The Leeward Rivergate
premise: Sebastian Montrose, a desert ranger chasing a thief who stole his father's compass, is forced to team up with the thief, Isla Reyes, when an old rival of his late father hires them both for a forbidden job: salvaging the Leeward Rivergate, a wrecked prison ship sunk in a glacier-carved fjord that holds proof of a magistrate's crimes. Racing a salvage fleet and the six tides before calving season opens the route, Sebastian discovers the debt he carries was manufactured by the very man who hired him. In the end, they beat the fleet by one tide, expose the magistrate with the ship's sealed manifest, and choose each other as crew over any reward.
about_author: Coral Vasquez is a former river guide who spent a decade running glacial waterways before turning to fiction full-time. She writes adventure stories about people who find family in the wildest, most unforgiving places on earth.

chapters.title: Nothing but Sand and a Debt
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: tracking the thief Isla across the salt flats, Sebastian catches her at dusk and discovers she stole not for coin but because the compass points somewhere it shouldn't. The emotional beat is reluctant curiosity replacing rage — the compass needle swings toward the coast, toward a name he swore never to hear again.

chapters.title: The Rival at the Rivergate Inn
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: Aldous Crane, his father's old rival, offers to clear Sebastian's debt if the crew salvages the Leeward Rivergate before the salvage fleet arrives. Isla vouches for the impossible route. The beat is temptation laced with dread; Sebastian recognizes the job his father died refusing.

chapters.title: A Crew Sworn Off
chapters.summary: POV Isla: recruiting the scattered remnants of her old crew — engineer Tam, diver Okafor, cook Brannigan — each of whom left after the last disaster. The beat is guilt and second chances; every refusal hides an old wound, and every yes costs something.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: studying tide charts and glacier calendars aboard the patched ketch Vagrant Mercy, the crew learns they have exactly six tidal windows before calving season seals the fjord. The beat is mounting pressure as Crane's timeline proves suspiciously precise.

chapters.title: The Fleet at Anchor
chapters.summary: POV Isla: spotting the magistrate-backed salvage fleet already at sea, commanded by Captain Verity Sloane, a woman Isla once betrayed. The beat is paranoia and old shame; Sloane signals recognition across the water, promising this will be personal.

chapters.title: Icebound Passage
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: navigating the first tide through pack ice, Tam's engine fails and Okafor dives into freezing water to free the rudder. The beat is terror becoming trust — the crew works as one for the first time, and Sebastian stops counting them as strangers.

chapters.title: What the Compass Wants
chapters.summary: POV Isla: confessing she stole the compass because it belonged to her mother, who died aboard the Leeward Rivergate as a prisoner. The beat is grief shared in the dark hold; Sebastian realizes their debts are tangled in the same crime.

chapters.title: Sloane's Parley
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: Sloane boards under a white flag, offering to buy them out and revealing that Crane sold the fleet their route. The beat is betrayal cracking the crew's fragile unity; Sebastian refuses to believe it until he finds Crane's coded ledger.

chapters.title: The Ledger
chapters.summary: POV Isla: decoding Crane's ledger with Tam, discovering Sebastian's debt was fabricated by Crane to force him onto this job. The beat is cold fury; Isla must decide whether to tell Sebastian or protect the mission.

chapters.title: Third Tide, Rising Water
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: the third dive reaches the Rivergate's hull, but a collapse traps Okafor inside a flooded corridor. The beat is desperation; Sebastian goes down after him against all sense, and they surface changed — brothers now.

chapters.title: Crane's Confession
chapters.summary: POV Isla: confronting Crane mid-voyage, learning he wants the manifest not for justice but leverage over the magistrate who ruined him. The beat is moral vertigo; the enemy of their enemy may be worse than either.

chapters.title: Mutiny Weather
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: a storm forces the Vagrant Mercy into a hidden cove where the crew votes on whether to finish the job or sell out to Sloane. The beat is found family tested by fear; the vote holds, barely, because Isla speaks for her mother.

chapters.title: The Prisoner's Door
chapters.summary: POV Isla: diving into the wreck's hold, Isla finds her mother's cell and a hidden strongbox of documents the prisoners smuggled for years. The beat is communion with the dead; she surfaces weeping and resolved.

chapters.title: Fleet on the Horizon
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: with two tides left, Sloane's ships close in and Crane sabotages the Vagrant Mercy to force a deal. The beat is betrayal made flesh; Sebastian maroons Crane on an ice shelf rather than let him doom them all.

chapters.title: Fourth Tide: The Race
chapters.summary: POV Isla: repairing the sabotage while dodging Sloane's boarding boats, Tam rigs a desperate run through uncharted shallows. The beat is exhilaration edged with despair; they gain ground but lose their reserve fuel.

chapters.title: Fifth Tide: The Manifest
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: the final dive recovers the sealed manifest naming the magistrate's victims, including Sebastian's father, who died trying to deliver it years ago. The beat is devastating clarity; the debt he carried was his father's unfinished work.

chapters.title: Calving Season Opens
chapters.summary: POV Isla: the glacier begins to calve early, sealing the fjord mouth ahead of schedule with Sloane's fleet trapped outside and the Vagrant Mercy trapped within. The beat is awe and dread; nature renders the whole race moot unless they find another way out.

chapters.title: The Back Channel
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: Okafor remembers a meltwater channel from his diving surveys; the crew threads the collapsing ice on foot and by raft, carrying the manifest. The beat is sacrifice — Brannigan stays behind to signal Sloane's fleet away from the true exit.

chapters.title: Verdict at Sea
chapters.summary: POV Isla: cornered by Sloane in open water, Isla shows her the manifest instead of fighting. The beat is unexpected mercy; Sloane, whose brother was on the prisoner rolls, turns her fleet around and becomes their witness.

chapters.title: The Magistrate's Court
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: delivering the manifest to a coastal tribunal, the crew faces the magistrate's armed retainers in a standoff on the courthouse steps. The beat is justice outside the law; the crowd of freed prisoners' families tips the balance before blood is spilled.

chapters.title: Debts Cancelled
chapters.summary: POV Isla: with the magistrate arrested and Crane recovered half-frozen and ruined, the crew divides the salvage rights honestly. The beat is quiet reckoning; Sebastian burns the forged debt paper and asks Isla what comes next.

chapters.title: Crew of the Vagrant Mercy
chapters.summary: POV Sebastian: the crew refits the ketch and sails north on a new charter — finding other wrecks that hold other truths. The beat is belonging; the compass, passed between them, finally points wherever they choose to go together.
